text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Knock, knock...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me?

Trainer
<username>?

Are you there?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Oh, good. I was hoping to give this to
you in
person.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: It was just released today.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: The Twinkle Monthly Special Issue.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Recently, many readers have been
requesting a
compilation of events in the
racing world over the
past three years.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
So they surely also realize how impactful
these
past three years have been.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: So many things have happened.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
As a reporter, I feel very fortunate to
have been
able to cover these three
years.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: And also that I was able to meet you.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Oh, and one other thing...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Have you seen the cover?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Yes, take a look.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At Otonashi's insistence, I look at the
cover and
see...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A large photo of <chrname>
adorns
the front page.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
When I was trying to decide who should
be the
face of this special edition...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Only one possible candidate came to
mind.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
And that was the opinion of the editorial

department as well.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
We at Twinkle Monthly will continue
covering
<chrname>'s
exploits. And of course...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
We'll be following you with great
interest as well.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
After all the interviews I've done to
date, I'm
convinced you two are the light
that will guide
the racing world forward.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
choice_data_list: はい！俺も彼女を輝かせます！
はい！私も彼女を輝かせます！
choice_data_list_en: Yes! I'll make her shine too!
Yes! I'll make her shine too!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: That... Th-that's s-s-s...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Simply amazing!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
You want to make your trainee shine
even
brighter! Even if it means you'll
only be the
shadow behind her!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Dedicating all your time to her, all your
money
even, and bringing her to races
all around to
pursue her dreams!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Aah... You're just as amazing as I
imagined you to
be!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For whatever reason, Reporter Otonashi
loses
control of her excitement, like
always.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But this magazine conveys her true
feelings. I'll be
sure to show it to
<chrname> later!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
For this special edition, we tried
something a
little different.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Hehe, please flip towards the back.
choice_data_list_en: What kind of project is it?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At Otonashi's insistence, I flip to the
back half of
the magazine.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And there I see...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"Dear <chrname> and

Trainer
<username>."

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
You see, the editorial department has
received
no small number of fan letters
from readers
addressed to the two of
you.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Seeing that enthusiasm, we decided to
create a
special section displaying all
those words of
support.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
This is pretty much the first time we've
devoted
multiple pages solely to letters
from our readers.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Please be sure to convey that
gratitude to
all the fans you see at races
and concerts.
choice_data_list: ありがとうございます……！

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
If I'm able to help connect you two with
your fans,
it means I'm doing my job as a
reporter.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This article conveys Reporter Otonashi's
true
feelings. I'll be sure to show it to

<chrname> later!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Could you please skip a few pages
ahead?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Yes, take a look.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At Otonashi's insistence, I flip back a
few pages
and see...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A special feature titled "Pursuing Glory
with
<chrname> and Her
Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
It's impossible to talk about the last
three years
of Umamusume racing
without bringing up you
two.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Your story deserved much more than a
small
article. So, I did a little negotiating
with the
editor-in-chief.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
I knew all our readers would be excited
to see a
special feature on you two.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Of course, I'm no exception. I’m
more
excited than anyone to see your
future exploits.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This article conveys Reporter Otonashi's
true
feelings. I'll be sure to show it to

<chrname> later!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Have you looked at the right side of that
page
yet?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Yes, take a look.
choice_data_list_en: The one on the far right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's a small special feature titled "A
Promising
Trainer and Trainee."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It includes scenes of my training sessions
with
<chrname> along with
Otonashi's
enthusiastic comments.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"I can't wait to see how far these two can
go!"
...And I meant every word.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I intend to continue covering the
path you
both take from here on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This article conveys Reporter Otonashi's
true
feelings. I'll be sure to show it to

<chrname> later!
